content.short: Redo is a prominent community-focused social token on TON, celebrating the network's heritage and growth.
content.description: Redo (Resistance Dog) is a significant community-driven social token on the TON blockchain, inspired by the iconic 'Resistance Dog' symbol that represents digital freedom and the fight against censorship. The project celebrates the heritage of the TON network and its deep roots in the Telegram community. Redo has built a passionate following of 'believers' who support the long-term vision of a decentralized and open network. It serves as both a cultural touchstone and a focal point for community engagement and collective action within the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Support the movement with Redo, the community token of TON. Discover social tokens on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
